description: Use the completed cell-QC/peak-QC ATAC checkpoint; do not rerun upstream filtering.
Verify the source has the expected cell, peak, tissue and tissue-cell-type group counts.
Retain all source tissue_cell_type groups; never filter groups by their size.
With seed 20261028, sample min(200, available cells) without replacement within each sorted group.
Retain every cell in groups smaller than the target; do not duplicate cells to fill quotas.
TC and SCZ share exactly the same selected cells; preserve their original full-ATAC UMAP coordinates.
Retain every original post-QC ATAC peak row, including rows that become zero in the sampled cells.
Start GWAS selection from existing pruned, strand-unambiguous tables.
Require finite valid summary statistics, MAF >= 0.05, unique rsID/coordinate, and a reference-genotype match.
Require overlap with an autosomal post-QC peak having at least one count among the selected cells.
This eligibility criterion constructs demonstration inputs; it is not post-mapping matrix QC.
All eligible SNPs are retained in genomic order.
Retain every reference individual and match genotype rows exactly to the selected GWAS rsIDs.
Do not apply the 20-cells/10-SNPs/20-peaks further matrix QC thresholds.
Create inputs and validate fragment counts only; do not run EPIC2 analysis or generate a vignette.
